title: Read-only federation journal diagnostic route GET /api/federation/journal (S5 evidence)
outcome: Split out of M4 increment 2 (w-01da81a029e7) to keep that repair round tight (Fable2's decision on Sol-a7bb #850). Specified by Architect1 (#11 to Sol-a7bb; ruling note be1e2ee7 on w-e41b7112372a) as the read-only diagnostic the first native exchange (w-574269147730) needs for its evidence. It adds one read-only route on every host, GET /api/federation/journal, served on the local operator surface: bounded pages of at most 100, newest first, no payload bytes, no mutation and no new table. It lists executor operations (key, kind, stage, effect, target binding, mirror flag = target_host_id ≠ self), and on the central host the wake obligations (state, exclusion reason capacity|stale_authority|unsupported, mirror present). It must be in the build that S3 installs on both hosts; it lands after M4 increment 2, or carries onto it.
acceptance: GET /api/federation/journal on the local operator surface returns bounded newest-first pages (at most 100 entries, with a continuation) of executor operations with key, kind, stage, effect state, target binding and mirror flag, and on the central host the wake obligations with state, exclusion reason and mirror presence; it returns no payload bytes, performs no mutation and adds no persisted object; tests cover paging, the mirror flag, exclusion reasons and refusal on non-operator surfaces. On the central host the response also reports the dispatcher scan floor rowid, rows scanned in the last pass, window occupancy, and excluded counts by reason as read-only diagnostic observations. Each executor operation also reports queueEntryPresent, deliveryAttemptPresent and runtimeAckPresent as booleans, and processedEvidenceKind as null, mailbox_ack or command_outcome, without exposing the evidence values.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact input with an independent Codex plus Claude review pair and no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
